goal: A Python CLI tool that scans a specified directory for image files (PNG, JPG) and PDF files. It uses a local OCR library (like pytesseract) to extract text, then applies regex rules to identify vendor, date, and amount fields. It outputs a structured CSV/JSON file and supports simple tax categorization rules. No external APIs or cloud sync.
acceptance_criteria: Tool scans specified directory for .png, .jpg, and .pdf files.
Tool uses pytesseract to extract text from files.
Regex patterns successfully identify vendor name, date, and amount.
Tool outputs parsed data to a structured CSV/JSON file.
Tax categorization rules are applied and stored in a lookup table.
